description: Memory filtering policy with deterministic rules

hard_store_conditions.description: Memories meeting ANY of these conditions are always stored

rules.name: novel_knowledge_creation
rules.rationale: Novel insights are valuable learning opportunities

rules.name: belief_revision
rules.rationale: A revised or contradicted belief is what learning is made of

rules.name: epistemic_change
rules.rationale: Resolving uncertainty changes what the substrate believes

rules.name: strategy_adaptation
rules.rationale: Which approaches were tried is needed to choose again

rules.name: behavioral_consequence
rules.rationale: Episodes that affect future action must be recoverable

rules.name: novel_connection
rules.rationale: First occurrences and new connections are not reproducible later

rules.name: substantive_analysis
rules.condition: query.query_type IN [ANALYSIS, SYNTHESIS, COMPLEX_REASONING] AND cognition.complexity_score >= 0.3
rules.rationale: Analysis and synthesis with meaningful complexity should be retained

hard_reject_conditions.description: Memories meeting ANY of these conditions are never stored

rules.name: trivial_factual_lookup
rules.condition: query.query_type == FACTUAL_LOOKUP AND cognition.reasoning_steps < 2 AND NOT novelty.is_novel
rules.rationale: Simple fact lookups don't need to be remembered

rules.name: no_reusability
rules.condition: criticality.reusability == NONE AND criticality.consequence_level in [NONE, LOW]
rules.rationale: One-time calculations with low impact can be discarded

soft_threshold_conditions.description: Memories not matching hard rules are evaluated on these thresholds

rules.name: recurrence_value
rules.condition: criticality.reusability IN [HIGH, MEDIUM] AND criticality.likely_reference_count >= min_likely_reference_count
rules.rationale: Episodes expected to be read again are worth keeping

soft_threshold_conditions.rationale: Allow moderate-complexity reasoning to be stored

calibration_settings.description: Verify self-reported metadata on 5% of stored memories

checks.name: complexity_corroboration
checks.verify: a claimed cognition.complexity_score >= 0.6 is backed by at least one semantic signal (novelty, contradiction, first occurrence, cross-domain synthesis, uncertainty resolved, backtracking, multiple strategies, actionable, new knowledge)

alert_on_excessive_rejections.description: Alert if >90% of memories are being rejected
